note: Batch simulate no longer needs a motor before it will find you one. It was gated on the topmost mount that already had a motor assigned rather than on the rocket having a motor mount, so a design you had just opened with nothing loaded was told it had no motor mount and the feature was switched off - backwards, since batch simulation exists to find you a motor. It now opens on any rocket with a mount. This was what lay behind "batch simulate appears to be broken": two single-stage .ork files saved out of MMRSim carry no motor assignment, so on both of them the button was dead.
